preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 200
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 200) representing the number of test cases.
For each test case, the first line contains exactly two space-separated integers N and k (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5, 0 ≤ k ≤ 10^18).

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains exactly N space-separated non-negative integers A_i (0 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^18).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is within the constraint 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= 10**18 for _, k in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, k is within the constraint 0 ≤ k ≤ 10^18.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(a) <= 10**18 for a in line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, all A_i are within the constraint 0 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^18.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i] == str(count_pairs(N, k, A)) for i, (N, k, A) in enumerate(zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]], [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2]])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output line is the count of valid pairs (i, j) where 1 ≤ i < j ≤ N and (A[i] | A[j]) + (A[i] ^ A[j]) + (A[i] & A[j]) == k + A[j].

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line) <= (N * (N - 1)) // 2 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is a non-negative integer representing the count of valid pairs, which cannot exceed the maximum possible pairs (N choose 2).
